senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פָּגַע)to strike against, meet, v. infra.

units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:4">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>נִפְגַּשִׁתִּי עם המלאך וכ׳</he> I wrestled with the angel and defeated him; <he>אתה נִפְגַּשְׁתָּ וכ׳</he> thou didst meet the angel in thy territory; Yalk. ib. 951 <he>פָּגַשְׁתִּי</he>, <he>פָּגַּשְׁתָּ</he>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9">Deut. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 840">Yalk. Ps. 840</cite>. Y’lamd. to Gen. XLVIII, 1, quot. in Ar. <he>מִתְפַּגֵּשׁ</he>.
